meta.title: A vendor cannot read another vendor's bid
gaps: The vocabulary provides only bidUuid and does not provide a token identifying vendor B's bid, so the plan cannot prove that the read targets the other vendor's bid rather than the acting vendor's bid.

words.preconditions: A fresh published RFQ event with two QA vendors invited, each with a submitted bid; bidding still open.
steps: The invited QA vendor reads the bid.
words.expected: The app refuses the step the case is about with “Bid not found”, and never with a server error.
